name: The One
source:
Every hundreds of years or more, a male will be born, some say he will be a god amongst men who will save them as he will give them gifts that will make them
Stronger, faster, better.....
Others say he will be a devil or demon amongst the men for when he appears he brings war....
He is called "The One" and while he himself has no superpowers it is when he shares his seed...that those willing to receive it will gain super strength, speed, and possibly the ability to fly....
However others seek to use these powers for evil.....
It is written that there will be 4 men in the world chosen to master one of the four elements: Earth, Air, Water, and Fire...
These men are known as the "Dawn Knights" and they are chosen to protect "The One" and the world itself from certain Doom...
...It has been over 300 years... and the time has come for "The One" to come/cum again...

[From [url=https://coolpeng.itch.io/theone1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每隔数百年或更长时间，就会有一个男性诞生，有人说他将成为人类中的神，将拯救他们，因为他将赐予他们使他们成长的礼物
更强、更快、更好……
其他人说他将成为人类中的恶魔或恶魔，因为当他出现时，他会带来战争……
他被称为“The One”，虽然他本人没有超能力，但当他分享他的种子时……那些愿意接受它的人将获得超强的力量、速度，甚至可能获得飞行的能力……
然而其他人却试图利用这些力量来作恶……
据说世界上将有4个人被选中掌握四种元素之一：土、空气、水和火……
这些人被称为“黎明骑士”，他们被选来保护“独一者”和世界本身免受某些末日的侵害……
…已经过去了300多年…“The One”再次到来/暨的时候到了…

[来自[url=https://coolpeng.itch.io/theone1]Itch.io[/url]]
